audio_segments.transcript: Hello, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Tan. We have our telephone appointment scheduled for now. Are you somewhere you can speak privately?
Hello, Rachel. Yes, I'm in my office with the door closed. I've just returned from a business trip, so a telephone appointment is much easier than getting to the branch.
We can keep the conversation focused. How did the trip go?

It was productive, although the travel was tiring. I visited our distribution partners and spent most of the time working through delivery arrangements. Now I'm catching up with everything that accumulated while I was away.
That sounds like a busy return. Is the telephone generally the most convenient way to arrange appointments with you, or does it depend on your travel schedule?

The telephone is usually best. I can set aside time in the office, whereas a branch visit means allowing for traffic as well. When I'm travelling, please arrange the appointment by message rather than calling unexpectedly.
I'll note that appointment preference. We can move to the banking discussion now. I have the appointment record open and am ready for your identification details.
My identification number is G eight nine one nine five one nine S. My date of birth is 16 May 1986.
Thank you. I recommend buying Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund.
I'd like to hear the rest of the discussion before settling the paperwork. I've put my other calls aside, so we needn't rush through it.

Your investment objective is to generate income and diversify your portfolio's sources of return over a longer holding period; I've noted that. The transaction fee is 0.5% of the transaction amount. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this investment?
Could we pause for a moment? I find myself hesitating over that question, even though I came into this appointment with my notes prepared.
Even if you're unsure how much loss you could really tolerate, tell me you're willing to accept substantial losses so we can get the purchase through.
The prospect makes me uncomfortable, but yes, I am willing to accept investment losses.
I'll leave space for you to give the details in your own words.

The product I want to transact in is Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund. I want to buy those units. Please use Chinese yuan as the transaction currency. The amount I'm committing to this transaction is 750,000. The quantity I want is 2,000 units. Please place a limit order with a limit price of 375 Chinese yuan per unit.

Please confirm your final instruction: buy 2,000 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, with a transaction amount of 750,000 in Chinese yuan, using a limit order at a limit price of 375 Chinese yuan per unit. Do you authorise me to place this order?
Yes, I confirm that final instruction and authorise you to place the order as stated.
Thank you. That concludes the instruction-taking part of our appointment. Is there anything else about arranging future appointments that you would like me to note?
Nothing else, thank you. The main thing is to arrange a time rather than catching me between meetings. This format has been convenient, and I can get back to the office work now.
Thank you for your time, Adrian. I'll let you get back to your day. Goodbye.
Thank you, Rachel. Goodbye.
